name: Canvas
instructions: A shared drawing canvas beside a thread. The person draws boxes, arrows, text and freehand strokes; agents draw too. Agents read a canvas with canvas_read or kg canvas show <name>, and change it with canvas_edit. Send pastes a short note with that command into a thread without pressing Enter. The canvas skill says how to draw a readable diagram.

tools.name: canvas_read
tools.description: Read a shared drawing canvas as one line per element. Without a name, lists the canvases.

tools.name: canvas_edit
tools.description: Draw on a shared canvas by applying a list of ops. Returns new ids and the lines that changed.
